name: craft
description: Personal Claude Code skills: my own bundles plus third-party skills pinned to reviewed commits.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Bundle for every project: craft-core (senior PRs, project docs, product lens, security gate, deepen hook) plus superpowers, Matt Pocock's planning/DDD skills and ponytail.

plugins.name: craft-core
plugins.description: My own core skills and hooks, no dependencies: senior-pr, security-gate, project-docs, product-lens, deepen (+ first-prompt hook, push guard, terse output style).

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Bundle for UI/UX: craft-web (ui-pipeline) plus stageshow, charles-unslop/polish, Emil Kowalski and Playwright. impeccable is opt-in.

plugins.name: craft-web
plugins.description: My own UI skill, no dependencies: ui-pipeline.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Heavy security engines the core security gate can call: Anthropic's security-guidance hooks and Cloudflare's security-audit skill.

plugins.name: oss
plugins.description: Open-source contribution flow and a merged-PR portfolio sync.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing in your own voice, and a figure check that recomputes every number you publish.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Third-party (obra/superpowers, MIT). Brainstorming, plans, TDD, debugging, subagent-driven development. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#superpowers

plugins.name: matt-eng
plugins.description: Third-party (mattpocock/skills, MIT), a subset: grill-with-docs, grilling, domain modeling (DDD), codebase design, spec and tickets. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#matt-eng

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Third-party (DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT). Simplest-solution mode: YAGNI, stdlib first. Has hooks. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#ponytail

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Third-party (Anthropic, Apache-2.0). Pattern warnings on edits plus LLM diff and commit review. Has hooks, network and a pip install. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#security-guidance

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Third-party (Cloudflare, MIT). Evidence-driven security audit with a findings schema and validators. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#security-audit

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Third-party (Anthropic, Apache-2.0). Create skills and run the description and eval loop. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#skill-creator

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Third-party (Microsoft, Apache-2.0). Drive a real browser from the shell for UI testing. Needs `npm i -g @playwright/cli`. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#playwright-cli

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Third-party (Paul Bakaus, Apache-2.0). OPT-IN: its hooks run a prebuilt engine binary with network access on every edit; the CLI requires --accept-impeccable. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#impeccable

plugins.name: stageshow
plugins.description: Third-party (Benji Taylor, MIT). Faux product UI and cursor demos in React and CSS. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#stageshow

plugins.name: charles-design
plugins.description: Third-party (LemonFace0309/charles-skills; MIT repo, charles-unslop is CC-BY-4.0). Unslop and polish. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#charles-design

plugins.name: emil-design-eng
plugins.description: Third-party (Emil Kowalski, MIT). Design engineering principles for UI polish and motion. Review: third_party/REVIEW.md#emil-design-eng
